shortDefinition.en: A lens with one nominal focal length rather than a zoom range.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 只有一个标称焦距、而非一个变焦范围的镜头。

en: Prime does not mean fixed focus. Focus distance and focal length are different quantities.
zh-cn: 定焦不等于不能对焦，对焦距离与焦距是不同物理量。

example.en: Built-in and detachable primes share the focal-length description, but attach differently.
example.zh-cn: 一体式定焦与可拆卸定焦都符合定焦描述，但连接方式不同。

en: A prime is designed around one nominal focal length, while a zoom covers a focal-length range. Neither description specifies focus distance or lens attachment. Moving the camera changes viewpoint; that is a different operation from zooming at a fixed viewpoint.
zh-cn: 定焦镜头围绕一个标称焦距设计，变焦镜头则覆盖一段焦距范围。两者都不直接指定对焦距离或镜头连接方式。移动相机改变观察位置，与固定机位变焦是不同操作。

sources.title: FUJIFILM GFX100RF Specifications
